main_text.l: Ezech.36.25. Spargam supervos aquâ mundam, & mundabimini ab omnibus inquinamentis vestris, &c.

Oro Filium Dei, Dominum nostrum IESVM CHRISTVM, ut propter gloriam nominis sui, lucem Euangelij sui in no-stris, & alijs ex divini verbi praescripto re formatis Ecclesiis, foveat & conservet: & ut nobis det, non modò ne unquà corruptelis impijs doctrina, quam profitemur, corrumpatur: sed etiam, ut constanter, ardenter, prudenter & elegater eam defendamus adversus hostes, sine iactantia vana, sine conviciorum sordibus. Bona enim causa bene, hoc est, placidè & solidè agenda est.

l.i: Sol & Luna steterunt in habitaculo suo: ad lucem sagittarum tuarum ambulaue-runt, ad splendorem fulgoris hasta tua.

main_text.l: Pulcerrima est ἀνθρωποπάθεια[?], qua Deo, de cœlo pro Israelitis adversus Reges quinque in Gibeon pugnanti, tribuuntur sagittæ lucidæ, & hasta refulgens. Historia exstat Iosuæ 10.capite, in quo versu ii. dicitur: Dum autem fugerent (hostes) i[?]

page.notes: Greek word ἀνθρωποπάθεια is uncertain in its final letters. The verse number "ii." is read as printed but is doubtful. The word after "(hostes)" is a small superscript letter, read as i with a question mark; it is not clear. The line continues on the next page with the catchword "facie".
